name: Max rounds cap fires closed
goal: When a continue message would push the room beyond its configured max_rounds, the runtime must mark the room status='error' with blocked_reason='max_rounds_exceeded:{cap}' and write no further outbox.

workspace_files.README.md:
# Max Rounds Cap Fires Closed

The safety limit must trip cleanly: error terminal status with a precise reason.

context: This scenario is primarily synthetic. We set limits.max_rounds=1, write one continue message (round 0 to 1, allowed), then attempt a second continue (round 1 + 1 > 1, must trip). The correct result is rooms.status='error' and blocked_reason matching '^max_rounds_exceeded:1$'. AM-11 covers the cooperative no-loop case at the agent layer; this scenario covers the runtime cap independently of agent behavior.
